# Sew True

> Handmade fabric door bows, plus sweatshirts and small goods, cut from real cloth and sewn one at a time by a one-person shop. Sold online in dated seasonal drops. Most pieces are one of one and are never remade. Ships anywhere in the US for a flat $6.

## What it sells

- Fabric door bows in several sizes, single and double layer, each one of one
- Appliqued sweatshirts and hoodies, a few of each size
- Small goods made from the offcuts, such as garland

## How buying works

- Each drop is announced with a date and time; nothing can be bought before it opens
- Checkout is by card through Stripe
- Flat $6 shipping, US addresses only
- Every piece is final sale; a piece that arrives damaged or not as described is put right if reported within 7 days with a photo
